title: Audition Gate
idiom: bold two-colour linocut, a gatekeeper listening before she opens
hero_prompt: Bold two-colour linocut print in black and rust red on cream, thick carved shapes, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible carved ink texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: a closed wooden garden gate in a low wall; just inside it a woman gatekeeper stands with her eyes closed and one hand cupped behind her ear, listening intently, her other hand resting on the latch; on the other side of the gate, close by, a young man plays a long wooden flute, and soft curling lines of sound pass over the top of the gate to her. Generous empty cream space.
icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a rust-red ground, no shading or gradients: a closed wooden gate with one large stylised ear set above it, three curved sound lines reaching the ear. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
